The Energy Department, Government of Punjab’s objective is clear: deliver reliable, hospital-safe, grid-tied solar PV generation totaling 5 MW across twelve public hospitals, with end-to-end accountability from site survey through design, supply, installation, testing, commissioning, DISCO net-metering approvals, staff training, and three-year operations and maintenance with performance assurances.

We understand that success will be measured not only by installed capacity, but by (i) safe execution within live healthcare environments, (ii) compliant electrical design and workmanship, (iii) timely net-metering approvals so energy benefits start immediately, and (iv) measurable operational performance supported by transparent, multi-site monitoring and disciplined O&M.

TechnoCore Engineering (Pvt) Ltd will treat this as a portfolio program—twelve sites executed under a single governance and quality system supported by our ISO 9001 certification and established nationwide footprint (HQ Islamabad with offices in Lahore and Karachi) [CO-PROFILE]. We recognize the requirement for site-specific surveys and detailed engineering per hospital; while our library evidences multiple completed solar deployments for federal and provincial government clients [CAP-020][CAP-008], it does not yet provide explicit artefacts of hospital-by-hospital solar design packages, so we will address this through a dedicated survey-to-design workstream with issuer review gates prior to procurement.

We also recognize the requirement for SCADA-based remote monitoring with a centralized dashboard; our evidence includes network design and deployment capability in provincial government settings [CAP-045], but our library does not yet evidence a hospital multi-site solar SCADA deployment, so we will propose an integrated monitoring solution validated through a pilot at the first commissioned hospital before fleet rollout.

On O&M, our in-country support desk model targets 24–48 hour response SLAs and quarterly preventive maintenance on O&M contracts [CO-PROFILE], forming the operational backbone for the required three-year comprehensive support.
